name: Boston Fern
hook: Crispy brown tips? Your Boston fern needs humid air.

steps.title: Bright, filtered light
steps.tip: Use an east window, or a south or west one with a sheer curtain. Harsh direct sun damages the leaves.

steps.title: Keep it evenly moist
steps.tip: Never let it dry out completely, but don't leave it soggy or standing in water. Water less in winter.

steps.title: Boost the humidity
steps.tip: Set the pot inside a bigger one lined with damp sphagnum moss, or mist it, especially in winter.

steps.title: Feed at half strength
steps.tip: Feed at half strength every 4–6 weeks while it grows, and little or none in winter. Too much browns the tips.

steps.title: Watch for scale
steps.tip: Check for scale, mealybugs and spider mites. Cut off any leaves covered in scale.

steps.title: Divide it in spring
steps.tip: Every few years in spring, cut the root ball into halves or quarters and pot each piece.

outro: Moist soil, humid air and soft light keep the leaves lush.

sources.title: Wisconsin Horticulture Extension: Boston Fern, Nephrolepis exaltata 'Bostoniensis'
